Karnataka Considers Nandini Milk Price Hike Amid Union Demands

Karnataka Chief Minister D K Shivakumar is considering an increase in the price of Nandini milk. This consideration follows demands from unions for a hike of Rs 8 to Rs 10 per litre. The Chief Minister is seeking data from other states regarding milk prices.
